Alex K: taking over primary for night switchover. quick status: scheduled infra patch window at 02:15-02:45 UTC, there is a short capacity drain on worker-pool-2. primary=Alex K, secondary=Maria S, fallback=Sam L. please ack and call out any handoff gaps. :wave:

Maria S: acked. I can cover 00:00-04:00 UTC. heads-up: scheduled db vacuum runs at 02:10 and may push CPU on infra-metrics-hosts. i’ll be near my laptop for the window.

Devon R: noted. runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff (bookmark this). quick check: if you need to pin a model or force-fallback, use the runtime toggle in console (Model -> Rollouts -> Force fallback).

Alex K: adding explicit paging rules here so we don't improvise: P1 = customer-impacting outage (all customers or major tenant down) -> page oncall phone immediately, open bridge, escalate to oncall-lead + EM. P2 = degraded latency or partial outage -> page primary pager (SMS/phone) and notify secondary if no ack in 10m. P3 = elevated errors but limited scope -> page Slack primary only, but escalate to secondary after 20m no ack. P4 = non-urgent tickets or morning follow-ups -> leave in triage, no pager. :rotating_light:

Sam L: what's the behavior for cross-region failures? do we route to other region automatically or keep callers pinned?

Devon R: smart routing will failover if region policy is set to "auto-failover"; check per-customer routing policy at Console -> Teams -> Routing. If customers are pinned, treat as P1 for those tenants and page immediately.

incident-bot: [scheduled-maintenance] vacuum job on infra-metrics-hosts at 2025-02-03T02:10:00Z. Expected CPU spike ~2-3 minutes. No action expected unless errors > 5% for 2+ mins.

Alex K: mitigation playbook snippets (copy/paste):
```
# quick triage checklist
1) check /status and /metrics (latency 95p, error-rate)
2) open bridge: run `incident create --sev P2 --title "nightly switchover triage"`
3) if API errors > 5% or latency > 300ms for >5min => escalate to oncall-lead
4) if primary unresponsive > 10m -> pd escalate --to secondary
```

Maria S: small tweak: make sure to capture customer impact tag in the incident: `impact: customer-facing` or `impact: internal-only`. this flows to billing/commops.

Alex K: paging contacts (canonical):
- Primary: Alex K (@alex)
- Secondary: Maria S (@maria)
- Fallback/oncall-lead: Sam L (@sam)
- EM escalation: Ben R (engineering manager) - page only for Sev1 or if instructed by oncall-lead

Devon R: concrete escalation flow timelines:
- Sev1: page phone -> start bridge within 5m -> oncall-lead notified immediately
- Sev2: page primary phone -> if no ack in 10m escalate to secondary -> if still no ack in 20m + customer impact then page oncall-lead
- Sev3: Slack page only -> if no ack in 20-30m, convert to Sev2 and page phone

Sam L: phone routing note: if primary doesn't pick up, use PD escalation: `pd escalate --service=redwood-inference --from=primary --to=secondary` (run from ops laptop). also call the pager at +1-555-0102 if PD fails.

Alex K: customer impact heuristics (quick rules to pick severity):
- Sev1 = complete outage for >1 region, >50% traffic impacted, or critical tenant down.
- Sev2 = sustained >10% errors or latency spikes affecting multiple customers for >5min.
- Sev3 = single-customer degradation or transient spikes <5min.
- Sev4 = non-urgent alerts, config drift, internal-only.

Maria S: reminder to annotate the incident with `rollout` tag if caused by a model or config rollout so Optimize team can correlate.

Devon R: runbook pointer for 'no ack' case: https://confluence.redwood.internal/playbooks/esc-no-ack. copy the escalation snippet into the incident notes if you escalate.

Alex K: last housekeeping: i'm on-call until 08:00 UTC. Maria will be primary coverage for 04:00-12:00 UTC tomorrow. if anyone sees anything odd during the vacuum window call it out asap. I'll ping again 15m before the patch. :thumbsup:

Maria S: thanks — will monitor logs and update incident if anything bubbles up.

incident-bot: [reminder] next handoff ping scheduled at 2025-02-03T01:55:00Z.
